changes: Fresh anonymous navigation checks persisted auth without downloading Firebase; existing IndexedDB/local/session sessions still restore; explicit auth actions load the SDK. Content user identity is isolated from form loading/error context.

Home and forum reuse server-rendered initial content; signed-in subscriptions and explicit additional-reply requests load realtime services on demand. Home selected articles/news send bounded server props instead of complete JSON fetches.
Optional widgets hidden by mobile CSS are not hydrated or fetched on mobile. Main forum threads and server discovery anchors remain in initial HTML.
Public recent-thread and vehicle community reads use server-side data instead of anonymous Firebase SDK. Authenticated submissions, reports, votes and messaging retain lazy service calls.

Wide ad rails load only when viewport has space; push notification manager requires an authenticated user. Ad placeholder loading/final geometry matches; forum responsive CSS is delivered as a module before paint.
Content Framer Motion wrappers replaced with small CSS animations; existing maps remain conditional dynamic imports.
Inter Latin/Turkish font self-hosted with next/font/local, swap and fallback metrics. Theme changes preserve the font class.
Unused hero CSS removed after a source search; 9.6KB profile styles and 5.4KB thread styles moved to route CSS modules.
Broad navigation route prefetch disabled where it downloaded unrelated library/data code. Real anchor hrefs and client navigation are retained.
TypeScript errors zero; ignoreBuildErrors=false. OBD/DNA/dictionary ISR HIT and public Cloudflare DYNAMIC/Cache-Control behavior verified.

mobile.method: Three consecutive valid Lighthouse 13.6 mobile navigation runs per template; select median performance run, never best run. Before is the original single-run baseline; repeatability data and raw local runs retained.

publicMobile.conditions: Three consecutive valid mobile Lighthouse runs per template, median performance run retained. Full SEO/BFS crawls had completed before these measurements started. Earlier measurement during crawls is retained separately as step09-live.json.
publicMobile.inp: INP not measured by navigation Lighthouse. TBT is a separate lab metric.

risks: Real-user INP is not measured by navigation Lighthouse; TBT is not reported as INP. Field INP needs post-release user/CrUX evidence.
Scores vary by host CPU; all three final repeats are retained instead of selecting a best result.
Next experimental analyzer emitted an nft.rs Option::unwrap warning while returning parsable diagnostics and exit 0; independent production build/tsc/network/SEO checks passed.
Lighthouse anonymous reads and auth persistence unit tests passed; no new real account or fabricated user content was created for testing.
Existing npm dependency audit reports 23 findings; no unrelated force upgrade was applied.
CSS inlining is experimental and increases initial HTML; its first-visit improvement was measured separately from JavaScript transfer.

A failed rollback caused intermediate HTTP 500 responses. The corrected final candidate was fully rechecked. See deployment-20261029/incident-and-recovery.json; interrupted scans are not accepted as final results.

inlineCss.tradeOff: Experimental option: removes stylesheet waterfalls; increases HTML and repeats CSS in RSC, reducing independent stylesheet cache reuse.
